import bpy, math
from mathutils import Vector

names=[
'OFICIAL | Passarela | piso continuo',
'OFICIAL | Passarela | cobertura',
'OFICIAL | Passarela | viga lateral A',
'OFICIAL | Passarela | viga lateral B',
'OFICIAL | Torre | cabecote alargado piso',
'OFICIAL | Terminal alto | galeria piso',
'OFICIAL | Terminal alto | piso de entrada',
]
for n in names:
 o=bpy.data.objects.get(n)
 if not o:
  print(n,'MISSING'); continue
 print(n)
 print(' LOC',tuple(round(v,4) for v in o.location))
 print(' DIMS_LOCAL',tuple(round(v,4) for v in o.dimensions))
 print(' ROT_DEG',tuple(round(math.degrees(v),4) for v in o.rotation_euler))

# Distances between key centers in XY
def xy(o): return Vector((o.location.x,o.location.y,0))
tower=bpy.data.objects['OFICIAL | Torre | cabecote alargado piso']
term=bpy.data.objects['OFICIAL | Terminal alto | galeria piso']
entry=bpy.data.objects['OFICIAL | Terminal alto | piso de entrada']
print('CENTER_DISTANCE_TOWER_TO_TERMINAL',round((xy(tower)-xy(term)).length,4))
print('CENTER_DISTANCE_TOWER_TO_ENTRY',round((xy(tower)-xy(entry)).length,4))
# floor elevation delta
low=bpy.data.objects['OFICIAL | Cidade Baixa | piso desembarque']
high=bpy.data.objects['OFICIAL | Terminal alto | piso de entrada']
low_top=low.location.z+low.dimensions.z/2
high_top=high.location.z+high.dimensions.z/2
print('LOW_FLOOR_TOP_Z',round(low_top,4))
print('HIGH_FLOOR_TOP_Z',round(high_top,4))
print('FLOOR_TO_FLOOR_DELTA',round(high_top-low_top,4))
